description: Recommended details shape for POLICY_VIOLATION errors. Provides policy reference and violated rules so agents can adjust requests.

category.description: Optional coarse policy category disclosed at the seller's discretion.

origin.description: Whose policy produced the rejection. Optional so undisclosed seller policies can return only the typed POLICY_VIOLATION code if even origin would reveal sensitive information.

policy_id.description: Shared policy-registry identifier for the violated policy. Use seller_policy_ref instead when the seller is not disclosing a registry policy.

policy_url.description: URL where the full policy can be reviewed

seller_policy_ref.description: Opaque seller-scoped reference that lets support and audit records correlate an undisclosed policy without publishing its rules. This is not a shared policy-registry ID.

title: Policy Violation Details
